nodes.text: You get a friend request from an unknown gamer who says they play the same game as you.

choices.label: Accept the request and start chatting
Pause and ask a trusted adult what to do

nodes.text: The gamer asks which school you go to and what area you live in.

choices.label: Say I do not share personal details online

nodes.text: A trusted adult reminds you that unknown people online may not be who they say they are.

choices.label: Do not reply, save the messages, and tell the trusted adult
Accept the request without sharing details

nodes.text: The gamer says, “Keep our chat secret. Do not tell any grown-ups.”

choices.label: Stop replying, save the messages, and tell a trusted adult
Keep chatting because it is a secret

nodes.text: You chose to protect your personal information and ask for support.
nodes.message: That was a strong choice. A trusted adult can help you report a cybercrime through 1930. CHILDLINE 1098 is free, 24 hours, and call 112 or ask an adult nearby to call if you are in immediate danger.

nodes.text: You shared some personal details, but you can still get help now.
nodes.message: You are not in trouble, and it is never your fault if someone asks for personal details. Stop replying, save the messages, and tell a trusted adult; they can contact 1930 for cybercrime help. CHILDLINE 1098 is free, 24 hours, and call 112 if you are in immediate danger.

nodes.text: Keeping a worrying online chat secret can make it harder to get help.
nodes.message: You deserve support and can choose a safer path next time. Stop replying, save the messages, and tell a trusted adult; they can contact 1930 for cybercrime help. CHILDLINE 1098 is free, 24 hours, and call 112 if you are in immediate danger.
